assumptions.noise: global depolarising estimate with an assumed error per two-qubit gate; not an IonQ result
assumptions.runtime: modelled: time = max(share_A/s_A, share_B/s_B) x job hours + comm fraction x job hours x cut fraction
assumptions.electricity: modelled: busy power while computing, idle power for the rest of the run (communication counted as idle time); power of a scenario device = average of the synthetic pool devices of that kind
assumptions.wall_clock: measured on the local computer; everything called runtime or electricity is modelled

references.LR-QAOA: J. A. Montanez-Barrera, K. Michielsen, 'Toward a linear-ramp QAOA protocol: evidence of a scaling advantage in solving some combinatorial optimization problems', npj Quantum Information 11, 131 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41534-025-01082-1, arXiv:2405.09169
references.CVaR: P. Kl. Barkoutsos, G. Nannicini, A. Robert, I. Tavernelli, S. Woerner, 'Improving Variational Quantum Optimization using CVaR', Quantum 4, 256 (2020), doi:10.22331/q-2020-04-20-256, arXiv:1907.04769
references.warm-start QAOA: D. J. Egger, J. Marecek, S. Woerner, 'Warm-starting quantum optimization', Quantum 5, 479 (2021), doi:10.22331/q-2021-06-17-479, arXiv:2009.10095
references.SPSA: J. C. Spall, 'Implementation of the simultaneous perturbation algorithm for stochastic optimization', IEEE Trans. Aerospace and Electronic Systems 34(3), 817-823 (1998), doi:10.1109/7.705889
references.Ising graph partitioning: A. Lucas, 'Ising formulations of many NP problems', Frontiers in Physics 2:5 (2014), doi:10.3389/fphy.2014.00005, arXiv:1302.5843
references.verification: citations and formulas were checked against the primary sources on 2026-10-10 before coding; our own choices (calibration by mean energy, epsilon = 0.05 for the continuous warm start, complement start for mixer B with fields, SPSA first-step size) are marked as ours in the code

tests.sign convention: LR-QAOA mean cost below: 72/72 instance-layer pairs; mixer-sign flip makes it worse than uniform on the example instances
tests.exact optimum and degeneracy equal Task: 0 instances compared; the others use a different lambda and were re-enumerated
tests.same evaluation budget for every optimis: budget 200; evaluations used (min-max): COBYLA 19-200, Nelder-Mead 36-200, Powell 50-200, L-BFGS-B 21-200, SPSA 200-200
